name: pr-sentinel
description: Agentic code review harness: an MCP server exposing GitHub tools and a self-verifying LLM review loop with a Next.js dashboard.
author: Ajay Chauhan <ajaychauhan.29dev@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pr-sentinel/mcp-server && npm run build -w @pr-sentinel/agent
scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm run build -w @pr-sentinel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @pr-sentinel/web
scripts.demo: npm run build && node packages/agent/dist/cli.js review demo/acme-shop#42 --provider mock --dry-run
